delhi.narrative: At 92 µg/m³ annual PM2.5, ~73,395 premature deaths/yr are attributable to pollution above the WHO guideline (₹366,977 cr/yr). A 30% NCAP-style cut would avert ~18,219 deaths/yr (₹91,095 cr/yr) — the funding case.
